You can also select different weather conditions to match your mood, or show random scenes. Relaxing weather views are great for stress relief while you check the weather!Ideal for your office desk, bedside table, or living room shelf. Always have the weather handy. Living Weather HD is the iPhone/iPad version of the popular Mac weather app “Living Weather HD”. Features: +Current national & world weather conditions, temperature and forecast +Animated, live weather background scenes matching current conditions, today's forecast or random weather scenes +Detailed forecast accessible with a single tap +Location can be selected by address, airport code or automatic location based detection +Sleep timer option+Relax and relieve stress with beautiful live weather views+Choose small, large or hidden weather widget display +Both imperial and metric temperature and wind speed units supported (Fº/mph or Cº/kmh)+Animated icons on the weather widget+Shake for flashlight option
